question: What initial yogic practice begins the sequence of experiential signs described?
premises: The root wheel is named as the first focus.
Practice of it is undertaken at a certain time.
This marks the beginning of a sequence.
inference: The sequence begins when one first practices upon the root wheel.
uncertainties: The fused form yadānyabhyasate is read as yadā abhyasate.
plain_english: O beloved, first, when one practices on the root wheel...
